mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN wm_stock_document d ON d.id=f.document_id AND d.source_execution_id=f.execution_id WHERE d.source_workorder_id=#{workorderId} AND f.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.output_qty),0) AS output_qty, COALESCE(SUM(component_totals.material_qty),0) AS material_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.output_qty>0 AND component_totals.line_count=1 AND component_totals.material_id=#{materialId} AND component_totals.unit_id=#{unitId} AND component_totals.material_qty>0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),0) AS invalid_count FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN wm_stock_document d ON d.id=f.document_id AND d.source_execution_id=f.execution_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT document_id,COUNT(*) line_count,MIN(material_id) material_id,MIN(unit_id) unit_id,SUM(quantity) material_qty FROM wm_stock_document_line GROUP BY document_id) component_totals ON component_totals.document_id=d.id WHERE d.source_workorder_id=#{workorderId} AND f.input_kind='PRODUCTION_INPUT' AND f.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND f.stock_applied=TRUE AND f.source_mode='LOCAL_ONLY' AND d.document_type='MATERIAL_ISSUE' AND d.status='POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wm_stock_document_line original_line JOIN wm_stock_action reversal ON reversal.reference_action_id=original_line.stock_action_id WHERE original_line.document_id=f.document_id AND reversal.action_type='REVERSAL')
SELECT r.id FROM wm_stock_document_line l JOIN wm_stock_action r ON r.reference_action_id=l.stock_action_id WHERE l.document_id=#{documentId} AND r.action_type='REVERSAL' ORDER BY r.id
